Use the existing metadata-first canonical regular-file/parent admission; require no symlink route, exact names and expected sizes/hashes, no '..' or absolute stdlib relative names, no duplicate names. Do not follow/read opaque caches.
Require the host lib/python312.zip route absent and the new capture/prefix absent before creation. Retain the first collision rather than overwrite.
Freeze admitted packet/source/host inputs against concurrent edits for this one invocation. This is scoped identity admission, not a claim of continuous loaded-code attestation.

Write a fresh root selection binding exact argv/cwd/four-key environment, review hashes, complete admission maps, final packet seal and literal timeout/combined-output bounds. No review or selection is inferred from this recipe.

Enforce timeout and combined capture bound externally; a per-file ulimit alone is not the combined-stream bound. Retain partial stdout/stderr and actual timeout/overflow/exit status; no automatic retry.
After exit, repeat the exact packet/source/interpreter/472-file admissions, require prefix absence and independently inspect complete actual output using EXPECTED_RESULT.json. Preserve any failure.

terminal_oracle.expected_fixed_report: EXPECTED_RESULT.json fixed_report_fields (all keys and ordered 38 result objects)
